engine.delivery: Silent push to the phone's prompt tray. Never on the main screen. One active prompt per player at a time.
engine.facilitator_override: Facilitators can fire any template, or free text, at any player from their console.

underserved: You haven't spoken to {name} yet. People who stay quiet at parties are usually holding something.
{name} has been on the edge of every conversation and inside none of them. Fix that.
contradiction: Two people have told you different stories about the same hour. One of them was {name}. Ask again, and watch their hands this time.
Something about {name}'s account doesn't sit right with what you heard elsewhere tonight. Find the seam.
proximity: You spent the evening in {zone}. So did {name}. They saw what you saw — or they'll claim they didn't.
Someone else was in {zone} when it mattered. Compare notes with {name}, carefully.
clue_linked: The board shows the {clue_name}. You know something about it nobody has said out loud: whose it is.
Everyone can read the {clue_name} on the screen. Only you can put a name to it. Decide what that's worth.

killer: Someone is getting close to {herring_name}. Help them get closer.
You've said too little about where you were. Volunteer your alibi to someone before they come asking for it.
detective: You still hold a sync. {name} has been talking a great deal without saying anything. Consider them.
Compare your syncs with the other investigators before the vote. A contradiction between two accounts is worth more than either alone.
jester: You look far too innocent right now. The {clue_name} is unattended.
Deflect a little worse. Deny a little too loudly. You know how this works.
minion: One of yours is drawing votes. Be seen doubting the case against them — gently.
inheritance: Your rival was seen {rival_seen_snippet}. You could let that circulate without your fingerprints on it.
villager: You know one true thing nobody has said out loud yet. Say it to the right person.
Ask {name} where they were when the lights went out. Watch the pause before the answer.

badge_scanning.mechanic: Every name tag carries a QR. Scanning someone logs an interaction edge with timestamp and both players' zones.
feeds: contradiction routing (who has told what to whom)
endgame stats screen: most-scanned, least-scanned, the pair who never spoke
badge_scanning.player_framing: Pitched at the party as a mingle game — scan everyone you meet. Never explained as telemetry.
